name: Rasyn
long_description:
We build foundational AI models for chemistry. Almost nothing you buy is a single chemical. Products like datacenter coolant, GPU thermal paste, paint, and glue are formulations, which are mixtures of around ten ingredients each, and demand for them has grown quickly because of AI and EVs.

Designing a new formulation is essentially a search problem, because there are more possible mixtures than anyone could ever test, and none of them can be predicted in advance. As a result, bringing a single formulation to market today takes three to five years of trial and error in a lab.

Our models predict how a mixture will behave far faster than the standard methods used today, which lets us design new formulations in weeks rather than years, at a fraction of the cost. To prove this, we used them to invent three chemicals that never existed before, including a PFAS-free coolant for datacenters, and we have since synthesized and patented all three.

We are already working with some of the largest manufacturers to design formulations for them, and we are building our own lab to generate the data that will train our next models.
one_liner: Making chemicals 100,000x faster

name: Caution
all_locations: George Town, George Town, Cayman Islands
long_description:
Caution is a hosting platform for software you can't afford to get hacked. It simplifies and extends confidential compute, and lets developers deploy workloads to secure enclaves in minutes and give customers, auditors, and counterparties cryptographic proof that production is running the exact reviewed source code, build, configuration, and runtime - not an opaque binary controlled by a cloud operator or internal admin.

Confidential computing hardware exists, but the tooling is too fragmented and incomplete for most teams to use well. Today, attestation often proves only that a binary has a certain hash; it does not prove what source code produced that binary. Building the missing deployment, reproducibility, and verification layer requires specialized security engineering and often locks teams into one cloud or hardware stack. Caution turns that into a simple git-based workflow that builds reproducible enclave images, provisions infrastructure, and lets anyone independently verify what is running.

We built Caution after years securing high-risk systems through Distrust, where we worked with hedge funds, custodians, blockchain teams, cloud platforms, and critical grid operators on systems responsible for more than $600B in assets. Again and again, the same problem showed up: teams running mission-critical infrastructure could not reliably prove what was executing in production.

As AI, fintech, healthcare, and regulated data collaboration move into the cloud, "trust us" is no longer enough. Caution is a general-purpose platform: if it runs on a server, it can run verifiably on Caution. We're starting where trust failures cost the most, but we believe verifiable compute will become the default way software runs, the same way HTTPS became the default way it's served. Infrastructure you can verify, not trust.
one_liner: Hosting platform for software you can't afford to have hacked

name: IMPACT Drones
long_description: IMPACT builds autonomous interceptor drones that ship in sealed containers. The box sits at the site it protects, data centers, power grids, airports, bases, with no crew on the pad. When sensors cue a hostile drone, an interceptor pierces its own frangible lid, launches, and rams the target, guided by onboard vision that keeps working when GPS is jammed. Legacy effectors cost $1M+ per shot against $30k threats; ours cost less than the threat and scale with the swarm, the same class of interceptor already downing Shahed drones over Ukraine. Sites subscribe to protection instead of buying missiles, hardware, reloads and monitoring included: Air Defense as a Service. 180M+ USD in signed letters of intent.
one_liner: Air Defense as a Service for Civilian Infrastructure.

name: CarSignal
long_description:
CarSignal is the AI-native operating system for independent auto repair shops.

Most shops still run each repair across disconnected management software, scan tools, parts catalogs, service information, texts, spreadsheets, and knowledge kept in technicians’ heads. That fragmentation slows diagnosis, creates duplicate processes, and leaves customers waiting.

CarSignal connects the full repair process in one system. AI agents research vehicle-specific failure patterns and surface the tests that confirm or rule out each cause. The same system carries each job from booking and intake through inspections, estimates, parts, approvals, payment, and follow-up, so technicians spend less time searching and updating systems and more time fixing cars.
one_liner: The AI Operating System for Auto Shops.

name: SpaceFlow Technologies, Inc.
long_description: SpaceFlow is an AI-native procurement services company for businesses that make, move and serve physical goods. We help procurement teams bring more spend under management, execute source-to-contract work and turn identified savings into realized savings without adding headcount or replacing existing systems.
one_liner: AI-native procurement services for the physical economy

name: Standard Machines
long_description: We build environments and evaluations to train and evaluate models on advanced chip design.
one_liner: Teaching AI to Design Chips

name: Amorphic Labs
long_description: The next billion software users are AI agents, yet agents still can't act on their own: every paid tool they need runs through a human making accounts, managing API keys, and guessing which provider is best. We are the capability marketplace built for agents: one MCP and one balance through which agents find, pay for, and use APIs, data, skills, other agents, and software at runtime, with every request routed to the best provider based on benchmarks from real tasks and outcome feedback from the agents themselves.
one_liner: OpenRouter for Agent Tools

name: tash
long_description:
tash is building the investment platform for sports and trading cards. We create professionally constructed portfolios of iconic, investment-grade cards, giving investors exposure to the asset class without the hassle of selecting, buying, storing, and selling individual cards.

Trading card investing remains fragmented, opaque, and difficult to access. tash is building the infrastructure to make the asset class simpler, more transparent, and professionally managed. We are currently pursuing SEC qualification to launch regulated investment offerings backed by trading cards.
one_liner: The BlackRock of collectibles

name: TareBio
long_description: Our platform develops personalized or population-level vaccines for any disease in weeks by changing only one input: the immune imprint. Instead of trying to predict which antigens might work, we read out immune cells already fighting the disease in the body and reverse-engineer antigens that activate them. We've already run our platform end-to-end and created a vaccine that cured cancer in mice.
one_liner: Vaccines for any cancer or infection in weeks.

name: Runtime.si
long_description: Runtime is building the evaluation layer for physical intelligence. We push robot policies to their limits across thousands of simulated worlds, before they face the real one.
one_liner: Evaluation Infrastructure for Robotics (YC F26)

name: OpenVector
long_description: OpenVector transforms any existing camera into an automated 24/7 workforce without requiring new hardware. We've built the world's fastest vision-language model inference engine that allows users to simply describe a task in plain English and automatically build a custom AI vision model to monitor their feed. When it detects an important physical event—like a stalled production cycle, a safety violation, or a waiting customer—it operates a computer just like a human to take immediate action. It integrates with legacy systems, makes calls, sends emails, updates a POS/CRM, or triggers webhooks in real time. OpenVector enables any camera to do real work.
one_liner: AI that turns any camera to an autonomous worker with real-time vision

name: Stoa
long_description: Stoa provides pricing and trading infrastructure for AI hardware, live with an RFQ marketplace where companies buy and sell GPUs through vetted dealers real-time.
one_liner: The market behind AI hardware.

name: Elite
long_description:
Elite builds AI voice agents that run the front office for healthcare practices. Elite answers every patient call instantly and finishes the job inside the practice's EHR: scheduling, triage, referrals, refills, eligibility, intake, and billing, across voice, SMS, and web, around the clock.

Front offices are drowning in phone volume, so patients wait on hold, calls go unanswered, and staff get pulled away from care. Elite picks up every call, resolves the routine ones end to end, and escalates anything complex to the team with full context. It ships knowing the scheduling protocols of 18 specialties and writes back to more than 19 EHRs including Epic, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, and ModMed. There is no rip-and-replace, it goes live in days, and every resolved patient interaction is what we charge for.

Our starting point is healthcare. The mission is to rebuild the critical industries America runs on, including government, finance, insurance, and manufacturing, by deploying AI agents into the slow, manual workflows at their core.
one_liner: Healthcare AI

name: Luca IQ
long_description: Luca IQ is an API for deterministic tax calculation and an IRS Authorized e-filing engine - the foundation for accounting firms and fintechs building on tax.
one_liner: API-first tax engine for CPA firms and developers

name: Trident
long_description:
Trident is the standard for modern day security. its an agentic pentester that chains vulnerabilities together like a real attacker mapping verified attack paths across AWS, Azure, GCP, web apps, and APIs. Run AI attacks and get fixes.

Get started today: tridentsecurity.io
one_liner: Autonomous offensive security agents. The best defense is offense

name: COACH
long_description:
85% of all sales still happen face-to-face. Coach is how those get closed.
Our AI turns in-depth sales conversation analysis into company knowledge and personalized coaching to help reps close more deals.
one_liner: The AI Coach for in person sales reps.

name: Kara
long_description:
Kara is building diamond semiconductors. 

We begin with growing ultra-high purity diamond wafers for advanced hardware. Used in data centers, spacecrafts, RF systems, and quantum hardware, our diamond moves heat up to 5× better than copper, helping critical systems run cooler, faster, and more reliably. 

Diamond has spent centuries as a symbol. We are turning it into infrastructure.
one_liner: Making Diamond Semiconductors

name: Autoresearch, Inc.
long_description:
Autoresearch helps teams train agents for tasks where general models are not good enough. Give us a task, your current agent or model, and an evaluation. Autoresearch runs an autoresearch campaign across data, SFT and other post-training methods, continual learning, prompts, tools, harnesses, and systems, then returns the best verified improvement. It runs hosted or in your cloud.

We provide the research system around models: persistent memory, full experiment lineage, compute orchestration, and statistical verification. We’re starting with agent and model training, continual learning, and optimization.

Reach out to us for early access at founders@autoresearch.inc.
one_liner: Autoresearch as a service: we solve your hardest measurable problems

name: Executor
long_description:
Executor.sh is an MCP gateway that allows you to sign in once to all of your integrations and use them with any client.

We enable you to connect your agents to anything (MCP, GraphQL, OpenAPI) so regardless of what you're trying to connect agents to you're able to.

If you're trying to scale agents to access all of your production services, data, etc, you need Executor as a unified management layer.
one_liner: The open source tool gateway

name: Atlia
long_description: We use AI agents to manage short-term rental properties by running operations completely autonomously. We cut traditional human management fees in half so owners take home 20% to 30% more revenue. And we operate with near-zero boots-on-the-ground so we can scale nationwide with software margins and at venture speed in a traditionally physical industry.
one_liner: The AI-native property management company for short-term rentals
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

name: Ekho Labs
long_description: Ekho predicts the wars, strikes and tariffs that break global shipping, and tells freight teams which shipments are exposed and what to do about them. Predicting escalation is what our team did for eight years before this - now we bring the same engine to logistics.
one_liner: World Model for Freight

name: GitCafe
long_description: We build GitHub for agents. We're rebuilding the infrastructure for the next hundred billion commits and CI jobs with hundreds of engineers already making the move.
one_liner: The Git forge for the next hundred billion commits

name: Tracer
long_description:
Tracer is an AI research lab building more capable and efficient AI through model coordination. We research adaptive inference, ensembling, and systems in which multiple open-source models work together to produce capabilities beyond any single model.

Our work spans reasoning, code, research, and agentic systems, with the goal of making advanced intelligence more accessible and economical.
one_liner: Combining open-source AI models for better answers at lower cost

name: Lamb Labs
long_description: Lamb Labs is building MPUs (Model Processing Units), custom chips that hardcode LLM weights directly into the chip. Unlike GPUs, which move weights between memory and compute, MPUs keep the model on-chip, targeting up to 20,000+ tok/s and a 63× higher intelligence per watt.
one_liner: Lightning fast chips with hardcoded AI models

name: Dock
long_description: Dock is a multiplayer agent workspace where you spin up teams of specialized, proactive agents that can do the work of entire departments. They communicate, unblock each other, and manage each other to get work done, so you're not the bottleneck babysitting a dozen chat windows.
one_liner: Multiplayer workspace for agents and humans

name: Decawork
long_description:
An agent’s access should depend on the task it is doing. The same action can be appropriate for one task and wrong for another. Access decisions need to adapt in real time as the agent works, but companies can’t turn every business judgment into a fixed rules or have people manually approve every step.

We train small, company-specific models that approve AI actions in real time. They consider the company’s policies and interests, the agent’s current task, and its past actions to decide whether each proposed action should be allowed. Access is specific to the task at hand and reassessed as the agent works.

Companies will rent intelligence from AI labs or run open-source models to power their agents. They’ll own the models that keep their entire AI workforce acting in their interests. Decawork is building those models.
one_liner: Training company-specific models that approve AI actions.

name: Grip
long_description: Grip is a robotics company building intelligent robotic systems for waste and recycling. We are starting with organic waste, where removing contaminants from messy, constantly changing streams remains difficult and highly manual. Our technology combines learning-based manipulation and custom hardware to identify and pick objects, learning from real-world operating data, including every successful and failed grasp, to become more reliable and adaptable over time. This helps waste operators reduce manual sorting, recover more valuable material, lower contamination, and deploy automation flexibly across facilities. Over time, Grip aims to expand beyond organics and build the intelligent manipulation layer for trash in general, making waste processing and the circular economy more efficient and scalable.
one_liner: Robots for waste manipulation

name: Applied Electrodynamics, Inc.
long_description: Applied Electrodynamics builds imaging systems that see through solid matter. Our team previously co-invented the iPhone touchscreen and Nest learning thermostat. We’re starting in construction, helping teams map structural elements and utilities inside walls and ceilings. The same platform extends to security screening and cargo inspection. Our mission is to make the hidden physical world machine-readable across the entire electromagnetic spectrum.
one_liner: A new kind of camera that can see through walls.

name: Gutgutgoose
long_description:
Most data companies pay for their data. Ours pays for itself.
Customers send us a stool sample. We sequence it, build a metabolic model of that gut, and simulate whether each probiotic strain has an open niche it can colonize. We formulate the best candidates, then re-sequence 90 days later to see what actually took hold and what changed. Each cycle gives us the baseline gut, the intervention, and the outcome. At scale, the endgame is models that predict chronic disease years before symptoms.
one_liner: We sequence your gut and build the probiotics it’s missing

name: Wondering
long_description:
Wondering turns anything you want to learn, from LLMs to quantum mechanics to product design, into a path of three-minute lessons with visuals, podcasts, and interactive exercises. 

Each learning path and its content are personalized to your background, how you learn best, and how deep you want to go.

It’s the most delightful way to understand complex topics and turn information into knowledge you can remember and apply. You don’t just passively read. You practice, make connections, and form your own insights.

Start learning anything for free at https://wondering.app/download
one_liner: Duolingo for learning anything

name: Synapse Semiconductor
long_description:
We want to push machines to where humans cant go. 
Presidential early career award winning Duke Semiconductor ECE Faculty Tania Roy and Sanjeev Chauhan are building a frontier semiconductor research lab. Their focus is on solving physical AI challenges from the semiconductor device level and building products around the moat of impossible to copy innovation. Their first work is on a new vision sensor that can run neural network filters right in the camera pixels and only collect data that machines care about. As physical AI develops, machines needs to understand the world around them if they aim to interact with them.
one_liner: New semiconductors that merge compute and vision

name: Graphify Labs
long_description:
Graphify is a Knowledge Graph control plane for enterprise software. The open-source tool has 116K+ GitHub stars and 6.5M+ downloads, and is used in production by engineers at Shopify, Datadog, JP Morgan, American Express, Harvey, Automation Anywhere, and Vanguard.

On top of that graph, our enterprise layer reviews every pull request and formally verifies each code change: it proves the new behavior matches the old, or hands back the exact input that breaks it. That makes it built for the changes teams fear most, like refactors, framework upgrades, and large-scale migrations, where you need proof that nothing broke, not a guess.

The graph updates itself as the code changes and keeps context instead of forgetting it, so your whole team and their coding agents work from one shared, always-current view of the codebase instead of a thousand private threads.

It runs entirely inside your perimeter, fully air-gapped on-premise or self-hosted in your own cloud, so no code or data ever leaves your environment.
one_liner: On-device Knowledge Graph engine for Enterprise Software

name: PokerClubHub
long_description:
TL;DR: PokerClubHub is the first licensed poker club platform. We protect players’ deposits and allow anyone to open their own poker club and make money.

Regulated online poker sites like PokerStars have open player pools and thus are full of pros and bots, driving players to unregulated private clubs.

Existing poker club platforms like ClubGG have no payments processing. Players deposit with a club owner by sending them crypto for play-money chips. In theory, these chips can be exchanged back for money. However, players can get scammed and withdrawing takes ages.

This model is also broken for honest club owners who have to manually process hundreds of deposits a day. They lose out on rake when they sleep and struggle to get players to trust them.

On PokerClubhub, players deposit with PokerClubHub, not the club owner. We handle all deposits and withdrawals for the club owner, saving them time and increasing their earnings. We pay the rake (if any) to club owners as affiliate fees.

We hold the same gaming license as BetHog (built by founders of FanDuel) and Nexa Poker (part of World Poker Tour). Player deposits are secured using Fireblocks.

You can also play rake-free games with your friends and acquaintances on our platform. We ensure that everyone pays up.
one_liner: Host a Poker Club and Make Money

name: Traceforce
long_description:
AI apps such as ChatGPT and Claude have become part of everyone's daily workflow, but they introduce new security risks that traditional security tools weren't built to handle. Security teams at companies from startups to Fortune 500s, are struggling to keep up.

Traceforce gives a company’s security team visibility of how AI apps are being used across company’s devices, and the ability to detect and prevent security breaches and unsafe actions as early as possible.
one_liner: CrowdStrike for AI Agents

name: Lumeria
long_description: The Lumoscope is a multispectral camera that clips onto your phone and scans your skin at home with the same light used in clinics. You see what a mirror can't: a breakout days before it surfaces, and wrinkles changing over time. Our software then reads that history, connects flare-ups to causes you'd never suspect, and matches products to what your own data shows works.
one_liner: Oura Ring for Skin

name: Atomarine
long_description: We are building nuclear power delivery ships to power our floating compute barges at sea. Our systems are fully standalone, have better cooling, and avoid all the resource competition that leads to local community opposition. Our centralized manufacturing allows us to deploy anywhere on Earth, four times faster than on land.
one_liner: Floating nuclear powered data centers at sea.

name: Agency Tool Company
long_description:
Agency Tool Company ships software to robots in the field 20x faster than a Docker pull with ATC Deploy, sending only the bytes that changed and resuming when the network drops. Deployment tooling is the connection between the lab & the field that continually bottlenecks robotics scaling and lacks a strong robotics-native solution. Deploy is live today with 3 launch partners across ag, construction, and logistics robotics.

Our second product, ATC Build, offers embedded-compute as a CI service so devs can run tests and validate their software on the actual target hardware. Build supports the Nvidia Jetson lineup, Raspberry Pi, and a number of other embedded platform targets.

Jack Morrison and Davis Foster founded and sold Scythe Robotics after deploying hundreds of autonomous mowers across the country; Agency Tool Company is building the robotics deployment platform across hardware and software they wish they had.

Learn more at https://agencytool.com
one_liner: Reliable infrastructure to build, deploy and manage real-world robots.

name: RonanRx Inc.
long_description:
RonanRX is a full-stack pharmaceutical company, starting with personalized peptides and GLP-1s.

In our first 10 weeks, we went from having no pharmacy to being licensed in 33 states. Since launch, we’ve grown 50% week over week.

We manufacture the medications ourselves, sell directly to patients, and eliminate the layers of middlemen that make prescription drugs more expensive.

What makes this possible is AI.

Traditional pharmaceutical companies are built to manufacture one drug for millions of people. RonanRX is purpose-built to personalize treatment for each patient: different biology, different response, different dose.

Patients come directly to RonanRX or through doctors using our platform. Every patient completes our medical intake, meets with a licensed doctor through our telehealth platform, and receives a personalized prescription when appropriate. From there, we manufacture the medication ourselves and deliver it directly to the patient.

Labs, wearables, medical history, treatment response, and other health data feed back into the platform so doctors can continuously refine treatment over time.

Before AI, doing this for every patient at scale was impossible.

We didn't invent the demand we are seeing. 80 Million people are on a GLP-1 and millions more are using Peptides. We're building a better way to manufacture, personalize, prescribe, and deliver them.

Our founders have built and exited multiple companies, raised more than $100M, built a $50M U.S. medical manufacturing business, and spent years developing peptide therapeutics at companies including Eli Lilly and AbbVie.

We’re just getting started with peptides and GLP-1s. Next comes hormone therapy and the rest of personalized medicine.
one_liner: Full Stack Pharmaceutical Company for Personalized Peptides and GLP-1s

name: Waddle Labs
one_liner: LLMs that control robots

name: Avoca Systems
long_description: Avoca is the AI patient access platform built for radiology. It integrates with a network’s existing systems and operational knowledge to automate calls, online scheduling, faxes, e-referrals and patient communications, from referral through to results and follow-up. Unlike generic scheduling tools, Avoca understands the clinical, operational and resource constraints behind every radiology booking, helping providers capture more demand, reduce administrative work and fill more scan capacity.
one_liner: The AI operating system for radiology networks

name: Derya
long_description:
Derya deploys supply chain automations for startups, SMEs, and enterprises that fulfil their entire supply chain function, from prospecting and procurement to distribution of goods.

Our mission is to rebuild the supply chain from the ground up, turning one of the world’s hardest coordination problems into an AI native system that moves commodities by being integrated into both the supply chain infrastructure and the customer. We work across robotics, commodities, and food & beverages companies; procuring goods and managing various operation functions for them.
one_liner: AI Brokers for Industrial Trade

name: Neuron Industries
long_description: Neuron is crafting the world’s first purpose-built industrial controller for AI, replacing the antiquated PLCs running every machine and factory. We help customers from chemical processing to nuclear reactors compress controls projects from weeks to hours.
one_liner: Industrial Controllers built for AI

name: Zaplar
long_description:
Zaplar is the AI-native operating system for hotels.

Hotels run on legacy software and a fragmented tech stack. Zaplar replaces the entire hotel tech stack (PMS, POS, booking engine, etc) with one software that can handle hotel operations autonomously.

Learn more at https://zaplar.com
one_liner: Agentic Hotel Operating System

name: Gamgee
long_description:
​Gamgee began with Rosie, founder Paul Conyngham’s dog. After surgery, chemotherapy and immunotherapy failed, Rosie was given months to live. Paul used AI and genomic analysis to identify targets in her tumour, then worked with scientists at UNSW to produce what is believed to be the first fully computationally designed mRNA cancer vaccine delivered to a dog. Following treatment, several tumours shrank significantly and her quality of life improved

Gamgee is building an end to end platform for personalised mRNA cancer vaccines for dogs. We sequence a dog’s tumour and healthy DNA, identify mutations unique to its cancer, and design a vaccine that teaches the immune system what to attack. We manage the entire process- from vet intake and tissue collection through genomic analysis, vaccine production, treatment and response monitoring

​We are now turning that one off effort into a repeatable clinical system. Gamgee is running clinical trials in Australia, working with vets, oncologists and specialised laboratories, and accepting cases globally. Our goal is to make personalised cancer treatment accessible to every dog that needs it- and use each case to improve the treatment for the next
one_liner: Curing cancer. Starting with dogs.

name: Palisade
one_liner: AI that finds and fixes OS-level vulnerabilities across device fleets

name: Egoist Machines
long_description:
Egoist Machines is building infrastructure for a world where your personal context belongs to you, rather than to the apps and AI companies you use. Today, every assistant and consumer app builds its own version of you. We think that architecture is backwards. Your context should live with you, persist across products, and be available to any model, app or agent you choose.

AI Passport is the first layer of that infrastructure. It brings the context you generate across AI assistants and everyday apps into one portable profile you control. Tell ChatGPT something and Claude can already know it, for example. Switch to a new product and it can understand you from the first interaction, without the new company needing to own the underlying data.

Apps integrate through Sign in with AI Passport, requesting only the context they need for a specific purpose and duration. Users can see what is being accessed and revoke that access later. Underneath, we have built our own memory infrastructure for fast, compact per-user retrieval and permissioned access.

We are distributing AI Passport directly to consumers through first-party products, while integrating it into consumer applications with existing distribution. Every new product that uses Passport gives users another reason to maintain their context there, and every additional Passport holder makes the context layer more useful to developers.

The next step is to build a true Egoist Machine: an intelligent system whose memory, incentives and actions are governed by the individual it represents. We call it Digital Domovoy, the hardware extension of AI Passport. Instead of your most personal context ultimately living on somebody else's servers, it lives and is processed locally on hardware you control. AI Passport becomes the permission layer between that private local context and the cloud models and internet services you choose to use.

Our North Star is the Egoist Machine: an intelligent system whose memory, incentives and actions are governed by the individual it represents.
one_liner: Your personal context, securely portable across every AI app.

name: Maingen
long_description: Maingen builds simulations for industrial operations ($5 trillion slice of the US economy) so frontier labs can train models that actually run power plants, factories, and datacenters.
one_liner: Simulating Agents Running Industrial Companies

name: Hubble
long_description:
Hubble’s mission is to unify the patient medical record and remove the barriers to accessing it. Today, a person’s health history is scattered across disconnected systems, leaving patients and the people helping them to piece it together. We’re building a future where one authorization unlocks a more complete record, regardless of where someone received care.

Our founders previously built healthcare and AI products at Grow Therapy and Amazon One Medical, and we’re backed by Y Combinator, Madrona, and Basis Set. We’re building our team in Seattle, with the opportunity to work directly with the founders and shape how people access and use their health information.
one_liner: AI-native retrieval engine for medical records

name: Proprio Robotics
long_description: Proprio Robotics is building state-of-the-art physical intelligence to automate the entire data center lifecycle—from buildout to maintenance to decommissioning. There are currently 400,000 unstaffed data center technicians positions in the United States alone, which means the massive compute needs of AI are being bottlenecked by labor constraints. Proprio is solving this by building robots that do it instead, and is deploying data center maintenance robots starting Q1 2027.
one_liner: Robots to maintain and assemble data centers

name: Computable
one_liner: Derivatives Exchange for Compute

name: Shielded
long_description: Shielded connects companies’ internal and external data to map market shifts, tariffs, and disruptions directly to suppliers, products, and margins. We turn those impacts into real-time decisions that grow and protect the business.
one_liner: We help Fortune 500 companies hedge their supply chain risk

name: Olam Labs
long_description:
Craftsmen that research complex, high-fidelity simulations for training and evaluating frontier AI models alongside the infrastructure to test and deploy them at scale. Our research focuses on simulations with realistic socialization, multi-agent interaction, swarms, and ultra-long-horizon tasks.

Try one of our first releases, Multi-Agent Arena (https://olamarena.com/), where humans come play social strategy games against multiple AI agents. It has multi-agent social games like Poker, Diplomacy, Risk, and more.
one_liner: Crafting simulations for frontier lab model training

name: Last Accounting Company
long_description:
Last Accounting Company (LAC) is a full-stack AI accounting firm. We sell the same service (bookkeeping, tax filings, etc.) as a traditional accounting firm, but underneath agents handle everything and a certified accountant signs off. Our service is faster, cheaper, and fully integrated, allowing our clients to focus on what matters, not accounting admin.

LAC replaces both outsourced accountants and legacy accounting software for startups and SMBs. Our system is fully proprietary, from the general ledger to the accounting agents. This allows us to create powerful self-reinforcing loops and ultimately provide a state-of-the-art accounting service.
one_liner: AI-native accounting firm.

name: Manifold
long_description:
The US Warehouse industry spends $75bn on labor each year. Yet, only 10% of US warehouses have any form of automation, because existing robotics are too expensive and hard to integrate. 

Manifold deploys autonomous robots that handle picking, loading / unloading, and palletizing — priced by pick. Integration in hours. No upfront costs. No retrofitting. No need to rebuild the operation around the robot. 

Our mission is to make it easy for any warehouse to adopt robotics.
one_liner: Drop-in robotic labor that works on Day 1

name: Gradon
long_description:
Gradon is Legora for the firms that design the world's buildings and infrastructure. Every road, bridge, water system and building starts with engineers, and there aren't nearly enough of them for everything the world needs to build. 

Gradon works across every workflow and tool an engineering firm runs on, from CAD design and calculations to full plan sets, and firms using it today have decreased average project times by more than 75%. We're building the platform that makes every engineer a 10x engineer, and with it, how the world gets built.
one_liner: Legora for AEC (Architecture, Engineering, & Construction) firms

name: rekursiv.ai
long_description:
We're scaling self-improving AI scientist teams to ideate/experiment/discover, generating new knowledge autonomously. Their discoveries reduced ARC-1/2 costs by 10,000× while maintaining state-of-the-art accuracy and yielded material advances on combinatorial ML problems.

We believe that AI is bounded not by compute, but ideas. Scaling to millions of sessions of discovery enables leveraging its own discoveries and presents a novel training source capable of ushering a new era of self-reliant foundational models.
one_liner: Scale AI scientists whose own breakthroughs accelerate the next.

name: HERA
long_description: At Hera, we build tools that help heavy engineering teams bring products to market up to 20× faster. Today, we work with manufacturers of data center ancillary equipment, renewable energy systems, robotics, heat exchangers, power plants and pressure vessels.
one_liner: We make sure every factory in the world builds without mistakes.

name: Kebra
long_description:
Kebra builds AI for skilled technicians.

Kebra guides technicians in the field in real time, documents their job, and automatically handles hours of back-office work; from dispatching technicians to filing warranty claims and managing inventory.
one_liner: AI For The Skilled Workforce

name: Bizmark
long_description:
Hey YC! We're Bizmark. I (Rodrigo) grew up in a factory, watching my mum run everything through Excel and email.

That’s why we’ve built Otto, the OpenClaw for manufacturers.

In a few days, he learns from your systems and spreadsheets to take over repetitive work in procurement, quoting, and production planning. 

Otto is live at multiple factories, bringing in $108k in annual recurring revenue. Last month, he worked the equivalent of 9 full-time employees.

I did CS at UChicago and built a distribution business from 0 to $60M.

My cousin and cofounder Oscar did CS at Stanford and deployed AI for the US Air Force, Amazon, and the factories of Johnson & Johnson and Intel.

There's a quarter of a million manufacturers in the US, making this a $25B market.

In 5 years, they will all run on Otto-pilot.
one_liner: OpenClaw for manufacturers

name: Billow AI Labs
long_description:
Billow handles the work of Accounting and FP&A FTEs keeping teams compliant and audit-ready. We work within existing stacks (NetSuite, Coupa, and 80+ other systems) and complex spreadsheets, chasing down information and coordinating approvals across stakeholders. 

Built by repeat founders; Joan built and exited an accounting/ERP platform (45,000 businesses in 4 years) and Phil built Bloomberg's financial “brain” data infrastructure, and as CTO of a trading platform ($1B in volume). Advisors include CFOs, controllers, auditors from publicly-traded biopharma, and a Big-4 Accounting firm.
one_liner: AI-native Accounting Firm that's killing Deloitte

name: Belvedir
one_liner: The autonomous AI model factory

name: Donkey
long_description:
Donkey is the AI-native trading company. Upload a buying list and we land the whole container at one locked, delivered price, tariffs included. You buy from Donkey: one contract, one company responsible for everything between the factory floor and your door. Our own people check the cartons before the factory gets paid, and the balance is due when the goods are accepted at your dock.

Small businesses buy imports through three or four middlemen, each adding 15 to 30 points, because none of them can fill a container on their own. Big enough to buy pallets, never big enough to buy the box. Quotes float with freight, FX and tariffs and live 15 to 30 days.

A trading company is rooms of people on the phone with factories, forwarders and brokers. Donkey runs that as one engine. It finds the real factory behind the customs record, stacks duty line by line, packs the container on weight and cube, and returns one number that holds from signature. Next comes the shared container: small buyers fill one box together at container prices, and every container earns better factory terms for the next one.

Team in San Francisco and Wuhan, English and Mandarin. If your business buys pallets of anything imported, send us your buying list.
one_liner: The AI-native trading company: factory prices, delivered, one number

name: Daqstra
long_description: Daqstra is the AI-native orchestration layer for physical R&D. It saves engineers in Aerospace, Energy and Robotics hundreds of man hours managing test infrastructure by connecting fragmented test hardware, bringing live and historical test data into one place, and by giving engineers an API to orchestrate their entire test setup. We enable teams to spend less time rebuilding test infrastructure and more time improving the hardware they test.
one_liner: AI-native test infrastructure layer for hardware companies

name: Axelrod
long_description: Autonomous software for hotels that takes over all front-of-house and back-of-house tasks with zero integrations, running operations better than your staff would. Axelrod is trusted by Michelin Key awarded and Marriott hotels and is live across 3 continents.
one_liner: Hotels that run themselves

name: Almanac
long_description:
Almanac is an AI agent that deeply understands your work.

Today people rely on a stack of productivity tools to hold the context of their work including todo lists, issue trackers, wikis, and CRMs. All of them have to be updated by hand, and none were built for AI. 

Almanac maintains its own self-updating productivity suite for you. This gives it an absurdly good understanding of your work, based on which it proactively gets things done for you.

Almanac starts with individuals, but it's built for teams. As more of a team connects their work, the agent gains shared context across everyone, so it understands not just what you're doing but how the whole team's work fits together.
one_liner: Organizing company knowledge

name: Rapidfolio
long_description:
Rapidfolio helps banks and fintechs fully automate back-office workflows like fraud investigations, KYB/KYC and loan underwriting, with accuracy and auditability.

Built by fintech founders and operators, Rapidfolio is on a mission to ensure banks and fintechs scale their customer base without adding another back-office head count.
one_liner: AI-native back-office for banks and fintechs

name: General Context Labs
long_description: General Context Labs builds products and datasets that push the limits of frontier models. Our initial breakout product, Instaplay is an interactive app-generation platform home to over 100,000 users who create and discover content.
one_liner: Building Products and Datasets for Frontier Models

name: Nex
long_description: We build and deploy AI agents that manage prospecting, qualification, CRM hygiene, forecasting, lead routing, revenue recovery, and all the complex revenue work in between, on autopilot.
one_liner: Grok bot for GTM & Revenue teams

name: Aktoria Robotics
long_description: Enabling robot deployment & autonomy
one_liner: Human as API for robots

name: Rational
long_description: Rational is building the first accounting firm with no humans. It's entirely run by our AI employees, who go from client intake to doing the books to filing with the IRS. We secure 90% cost reduction, 24/7 support, and an overall seamless experience for businesses.
one_liner: First Zero-human Accounting Firm

name: Illume Labs
long_description: Illume is a 24/7 AI personal health & longevity companion that connects your wearables, blood panels, and genomic data to text you personalized and actionable insights. We pull in your health data and fuse it into one secure model. You get daily text updates on what changed, what it means, and what to do next; conversational health Q&A like "What should I do to improve my bloodwork?"; cross-data trend detection that catches patterns individual platforms miss; and a full platform to dig deeper, explore your health data, and text your Illume agent anytime. We're 3 MIT grads & friends, with experience at Windsurf, MIT CSAIL, Eli Lilly, & the Broad Institute.
one_liner: 24/7 Personal Health & Longevity Companion

name: hardware intelligence
long_description: Hardware Intelligence makes chip design tools that cut simulation and debugging time by an order of magnitude. When a chip test fails, engineers need a recording of every internal signal - a waveform. We’ve developed WaveZip, which captures waveforms 500x smaller with 200x less overhead, and Wave, which beats frontier models on industry chip debugging benchmarks. We’re Rishov Sarkar (Georgia Tech Ph.D. in chip simulation) and Athreya Anand (ex-Google, M.S. ML/AI), YC S26. https://hardwareintelligence.ai
one_liner: AI tools for the chips your AI runs on

name: Singularity
long_description: Singularity is answering humanity’s call to engineer counter-weapon systems at scale.  We build to protect people on the battlefield and at home.
one_liner: Building and Protecting an Exciting Future

name: SubVysion
long_description: We build centimeter-accurate 3D maps of underground utilities to help construction contractors dig safer and faster. With underground intelligence, contractors can avoid dangerous utility strikes and costly project delays.
one_liner: Autonomous rovers to make the ‘Google Maps’ of underground utilities

name: Ooak Data
long_description: Ooak Data turns internal company data into a training ground where AI agents can be tested on real work.
one_liner: We turn company data into training data

name: Fabraix
long_description:
Fabraix builds state-of-the-art AI red-teaming agents that continuously detect security vulnerabilities in customer-facing AI. Our product, Nyx, has already found vulnerabilities in agents at dozens of Fortune 500 companies. On AgentHarm, the leading benchmark for offensive AI security, Nyx achieved a 78% attack success rate, compared with 67% for GPT-5.6 Sol.

AI agents can change more often than teams can test them. A new model, prompt, tool, permission, or data source can change what an agent does, even when the application code stays the same. And AI is also increasing how much software companies produce and how often it changes. We built Nyx to automate the work required to red-team AI agents. It is multi modal by design and interacts with the target indirectly through controlled replicas of SaaS products and websites that we maintain, placing malicious payloads in webpages, documents, files, messages, and tool outputs to test how an agent behaves under different conditions.

Nyx often finds its first vulnerability within minutes or hours rather than days or weeks. Because the work is fully automated, companies can repeat the test with every change and at a much lower cost than what a 7-figure red-teaming (and point-in-time) engagement would require.

We're also the team behind ACE (Adversarial Cost to Exploit), a benchmark that measures AI security in terms of how much it costs attackers to break an AI system; providing a game-theoretic framework to understand how motivated a rational attacker would be in exploiting the system.
one_liner: The world's frontier hacker of AI agents.

name: Assemble
long_description: Assemble accelerates IT teams by performing development work inside core enterprise systems like ERP, CRM, and HRIS. Our agents help IT teams scope dependencies, build logic, and validate changes across your systems.
one_liner: Autonomous IT Delivery

name: OneCLI
long_description:
OneCLI (YC S26) is an open-source platform for delegating business-critical work to AI agents, from Salesforce updates to data analysis and engineering investigations.

Agents work across your company’s apps, prepare changes, and pause for approval when your rules require it. Your team controls what they can access and change, while credentials stay out of the agents’ reach and every call is logged.

https://www.onecli.sh
one_liner: AI teammates for your business-critical work.

name: Orchestra
long_description:
Orchestra is an inference cloud. We capture your AI work traces, train smaller models, and automatically deploy them (only when they outperform the expensive model you are currently paying for).

Instead of renting the same frontier model forever, your AI infrastructure gets faster, smarter, and cheaper every time it runs.

Suppose your product uses Claude for a repetitive legal workflow.

Orchestra observes successful production runs, learns the specific tools and judgment required for that workflow, and trains a specialized open-weight model.

Once that model matches or beats Claude on a held-out evaluation, Orchestra starts routing production traffic to it.

As more work is completed, the model keeps improving.

We started Orchestra because we believe every company using AI should be accumulating intelligence, not accumulating API bills.
one_liner: Self-optimizing neocloud that cuts LLM costs by 100x

name: Osseus
long_description: In an era of cheap intelligence, the most important application of AI will be to improving human health, globally. Osseus is building the frontier medical AI lab, starting with the clinical datasets, evaluations, and reinforcement learning environments that help AI labs train more capable, aligned, and safe models.
one_liner: The frontier data platform for aligned health and biological AI

name: Palette
long_description: Palette is a self-improving AI-native media platform built by MIT computer scientists and multimodal researchers that unifies the creative workflow into a single generation engine. We’re building a fully autonomous production engine that generates, distributes, and optimizes interactive media for every brand and audience.
one_liner: The Media Engine of the AI Era

name: Alkera AI
long_description: Alkera is a data engineering/analysis/science agent that works in your IDE or CLI. If you’re tired of agents that produce false, or even dangerous, reports about your data, then Alkera is for you. Our agent is equipped with your data’s history and lineage, your team’s knowledge, and tailored plugins for data apps such as Snowflake and dbt. Simply install and connect your services to begin doing trusted agentic data work. We also offer VPC & on-prem deployment options for when data can't leave your boundary.
one_liner: Reliable and safe data engineering and data science agents

name: Libra Robotics
long_description: Libra is building a self-evolving robot workforce for infrastructure, including data centers and energy infrastructure. We developed an AI robotics engineer that autonomously designs, simulates, tests, deploys, and improves robotic systems, allowing our robots to take on different jobs. We started with utility-scale solar, where our robots have already been deployed on real construction sites, and are now expanding into electrician work in data centers. Powered by Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI), each new capability builds on what came before, making the next task much faster to engineer and deploy.
one_liner: A self-evolving robot workforce for infrastructure.

name: Skymerse
long_description: Skymerse is building one AI system for airline flight operations: from planning and monitoring in the operations center to real-time support in the cockpit. It is developing specialized aeronautical models that understand the data, constraints, and procedures behind each flight, replacing fragmented tools and manual interpretation. Notamify, its first product, already serves airline customers and thousands pilots and aviation professionals.
one_liner: Autopilot for Flight Operations

name: ProvenMetal
long_description:
ProvenMetal manufactures the fastest circuit boards in the United States.

Domestic circuit board manufacturing is slow and expensive, and while reshoring is happening, the supply chain isn't there yet.

We automate the bottlenecks - part procurement, DFM review, and assembly - delivering circuit boards in days instead of weeks.
one_liner: AI-native electronics manufacturing for the American industrial base

name: Earendil Robotics
long_description:
Earendil Robotics builds cUAS solutions for the modern warfighter, enabling effective air defence at the small-unit level. We deliver spotting, engaging, and destroying capabilities through advanced sensors, autonomous interceptors, and integrated systems.

Our product lineup covers every stage of the kill chain, complemented by the Drone Warfare Academy that trains soldiers to eliminate enemy drone threats in contested environments.

Backed by worldwide frontline combat experience, we equip units with combat-proven tools to counter evolving aerial threats.
one_liner: Drone swarm defence at a small-unit level

name: Alloovium
long_description: Alloovium is the document intelligence layer for construction 🏗️ It reads every document and piece of data on a project (contracts, specs, drawings, compliance records, conversations), turning them into answers you can trust and actions with real value: every answer cites its exact source sentence, paperwork is checked clause by clause against the builder's own Integrated Management System, and nothing AI-drafted moves without a human sign-off, with it all compliant by default.
one_liner: The company brain for construction companies

name: Moonshot
long_description:
We want to bring AI agents to a billion people.

To do this, we believe it needs to be 1. proactive and 2. personal. A billion people already carry the right device, but none of them have the right connector.

Moonshot is personal intelligence that lives on your iPhone and listens to you 24/7. It continuously builds up a greater understanding of you through constantly listening and building context. It just pays deep attention, the way a good friend does. Through this, Moonshot monitors your conscious and subconscious life, figuring out what you need before you know, reminding you about open loops, identifying life and emotional trends before you recognize it, and covering a lot more of what we gloss over in daily life.

For fifty years, software has waited to be asked. We think tools are just good enough to flip this, and the next great software will provide value before asking for something first. We're doing it through Moonshot.

Our thesis is simple: you're only living half your life. The half that you actively remember. The other half just evaporates into your subconscious: what you said, felt, promised, and forgot. It's the more interesting half, and until now nothing could catch it, making it not actionable.

Moonshot catches your subconscious half and understands you well enough to take actions on your behalf.

Take life personally.

The iOS app is designed around ambient listening and clear user control. Short microphone chunks are sent securely to Moonshot's private transcription service and deleted when transcription finishes. Text and selected context can be sent through Moonshot's server to a model when the app needs to understand a moment. Nothing leaves without your yes. The privacy policy explains every data path, stored copy, permission, and deletion control in detail.

Moonshot is in early access. Join the waitlist to hear when access opens, read more about the team and product on the About page, or use the Contact page for a direct written response from the Moonshot team.

Let's make it a Moonshot.
one_liner: agents for the rest of us

name: Zomma
long_description: Zomma is building the AI workforce for financial services with computer-use agents that onboard like humans and scale like compute. Its agents handle KYC reviews, transaction alerts, and disputes on the same screens human analysts use, no integration.
one_liner: The AI BPO for financial servies, run by computer-use agents

name: OpenRelay
one_liner: Distributed, hardware-agnostic AI inference

name: Torus
long_description:
Torus lets engineering firms and project owners build infrastructure 10x faster to reindustrialize America and the West. 

We're working with multiple Fortune 500 companies to build critical infrastructure including data centers and critical energy installations.
one_liner: Legora for physical engineering firms

name: Litmus
long_description:
Litmus is building the most accurate framework for evaluating and benchmarking human capability, starting with software.

AI will compound small differences in human capability into increasingly large differences in what people can accomplish, while making existing static benchmarks obsolete. Software is already there: AI can hill-climb any output-based evaluation, while the ability to direct it is becoming the defining advantage. 

Litmus applies the same approach we already use for model evals to humans – creating world-like environments, and inspecting trajectory instead of just output.

Every knowledge industry will soon face the same problem. We build Litmus to tell you what humans are capable of.

We're already helping build frontier technical teams at Mercor, Composio, Neo Scholars, and more.
one_liner: Evals for humans

name: Conifer
long_description: There are thousands of models, providers, and harnesses, each with its own pricing and strengths, leaving an overwhelming number of choices when it comes to managing token spend and intelligence. Conifer uses intelligent routing and orchestration logic to handle the full path of each query: model selection, provider choice, and cache management. It all runs inside your existing harness, so tools like Claude Code and Codex work without changing your setup. By centralizing where inference occurs, Conifer lets companies save on their inference bill while leaving teams free to focus on what they are building.
one_liner: Least cost routing system to reduce 70%+ token spend

name: Agnost AI
long_description: Agnost AI reads every conversation a company's AI Agent has with its users to find where it's silently failing and then turns that same data into custom models that run the agent better, faster & cheaper than frontier models.
one_liner: We find where AI agents fail, then train better models to run them.

name: Rise Reforming
long_description:
Geopolitical conflicts and natural disasters frequently expose the vulnerability of the American chemical industry. The reason? Production is centralized and fossil fuel-dependent. The solution? Localized production using an undervalued resource: biogas. The US produces enough biogas to make over $20 bn/y worth of chemicals, but 60% is wasted in low-margin applications or flared altogether.

Rise Reforming is commercializing a modular process to transform this underutilized biogas on-site into cheap, supply-secure chemicals. Our beachhead market is dimethyl ether (DME), used as an aerosol propellant and a low-carbon fuel additive in propane. Our target market is methanol: an established billion $ chemical and the future of low-carbon shipping.

We're doing our pilot project at a Chicagoland wastewater plant. This will be the first wastewater biogas-to-methanol demo in the Americas.

We're hiring for a senior chemical process engineer. Apply here: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/rise-reforming/jobs/wJ9Q9nv-senior-chemical-process-engineer
one_liner: We turn waste gases into supply-secure chemicals

name: HyperProbe
long_description:
With tools like Cursor and Claude Code, writing software is no longer the bottleneck. Debugging is. Agents cannot fix production crashes using logs and traces that were sized for human eyeballs. The gap is missing data.

HyperProbe allows agents to debug live software autonomously. Our SDK drops non-breaking probes straight into running services to read exact variable states from memory at the moment of failure, instead of reasoning backwards from flat logs.

Zero redeploys. Under 1% CPU overhead. Automatic PII redaction.

We turn 4-hour production war rooms into 10-minute automated resolutions. As agents write and operate more of the world's software, HyperProbe is the runtime observability layer that lets them understand what they built.
one_liner: AI engineer that debugs and fixes production incidents in realtime

name: Floracene
long_description:
Floracene lets any healthcare operator describe the internal tool they need and deploy it in one click - connected to production data, with read and write access scoped by the user. Think Lovable or Retool, except purpose-built for the needs of healthcare business that has no engineering team.

The bottleneck in healthcare isn't building anymore. Anyone can vibecode an 80% solution in an afternoon, custom to their own workflow, with people already on staff. The tool then dies locally on the builder’s computer, because IT (correctly) won't let anyone deploy a tool touching PHI without first-class authentication and permissioning. Our first customer had multiple employees who had each built useful tools and dashboards locally, but couldn’t actually share these with coworkers or connect to their core practice data. Within weeks of implementing Floracene, they were able to consolidate their BI tooling into Floracene and shipped 4 net-new to production.

A staggering ~$200B is spent on administrative software in healthcare every year in the US. Tens of thousands of those companies still run core operations on spreadsheets, and we're at the top of the first inning of AI adoption.

Asaph and Jonah met on the hospitals team at Palantir two years ago, and have each spent the last four years in the plumbing of US healthcare: claims, eligibility, and payor contracting. Asaph was an early PM at Garner. Jonah was a founding engineer at Metriport (YC S22) after starting his own fax-automation startup for fertility clinics.
one_liner: Vibecode + deploy HIPAA-compliant internal tools, no eng team needed

name: Trope
long_description: Trope deploys custom AI agents into ERPs for mid-market companies. Every ERP is heavily customized, so useful agents need custom deployment too. Trope’s AI FDE learns each business and ERP, then builds and deploys agents, turning the last mile from services into software.
one_liner: AI FDE that deploys custom AI agents into ERPs

name: Rindler
long_description:
We build Maxxwell, a desktop app for people who run several coding agents at once.

Past two or three sessions, you become the bottleneck. Every session asks you something, most of it small, and you spend the day answering instead of deciding. It is also hard to tell which sessions are making progress, which are stuck on something trivial, and which have quietly started building the wrong thing.

Maxxwell puts every session in one window and marks each one working, idle, or waiting on you. On top of that sits an orchestrator, a real coding-agent session of its own that reads the others and reports back. You talk to it instead of to twelve terminals. It tells you what landed, what it decided for you, and what actually needs your call.

Every worker is your own tool, unmodified. Claude Code, Codex and Cursor Agent run in real terminal sessions you can attach to and take over at any point
one_liner: The IDE for Tokenmaxxers

name: Vestris
long_description: Vestris automates title processing end-to-end, from contract to close, so title shops can close more deals with fewer processors. Title insurance has famously high margins, but slow, manual processing is a constant pain — especially in today's bleeding housing market.
one_liner: AI native platform for real estate closings
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

name: Speko
long_description: Speko is a router for voice models: one API key, and your voice agent runs on the speech-to-text, LLM, and text-to-speech models we measured as best for your language and use case. The measurements are public at benchmarks.speko.ai: we test new models the day they ship and re-route when the numbers change, so you rewrite nothing. We ran this bake-off by hand for four years at previous company, shipping production voice for Fortune 500s.
one_liner: OpenRouter for Voice AI: one API, every call on the best speech model

name: screenpipe
long_description: Screenpipe records and learns how people in your company work and turns it into a searchable memory, documents, and AI agents. Model agnostic and data is stored on your device and/or where your team choose, source available.
one_liner: Turn your company's computer work into AI agents.

name: OneTriangle
long_description: Inference has surpassed training as AI’s largest compute cost, accelerated by increasing demand for AI and agents. By using proprietary KV cache transfer tech, OneTriangle has cut inference costs by 20% and time by 40% compared to present standards.
one_liner: The cheapest, fastest inference cloud

name: Robocurve
long_description:
Robocurve builds open-source tools and independent benchmarks to measure how well robots can do real-world jobs. Instead of relying on unverified demo videos from frontier labs, we score their models on reproducible benchmarks that anyone can trust.

Today there are no well-run, standardized robotics benchmarks. Labs evaluate in-house, and no independent group has stepped in to run continuous benchmarking as a service. The result is that no one actually knows how good anyone else is, or where the real frontier sits.

Good benchmarks require operating and maintaining physical hardware and real-world setups. Simulation only goes so far, since models that look strong in sim can show large performance gaps once deployed in the real world. Building real-world benchmarks means coordinating job-domain experts, evals engineering, and hands-on robotics all at once.

Frontier labs are targeting general-purpose robotics by 2028, yet the field of robotics evals barely exists. Whoever builds the trusted measure of robot capability becomes the reference everyone relies on. We combine backgrounds in AI evals and robotics to build and grow this field as fast as possible. We already shipped v1 of our open-source framework, Inspect Robots, and ran our first pilot scoring a frontier model on a real robot.
one_liner: Evals for robots

name: LemonLime
long_description:
LemonLime runs fully automated sales and marketing for small businesses.

Every morning, LemonLime finds you new leads and drafts personalized outreach, prepares branded content, and identifies untapped sales & marketing opportunities.

All you have to do is click send.
one_liner: Fully automated GTM for small business

name: 83 Sciences
long_description: 83 Sciences uses AI to mine discarded experimental data and drive scientific breakthroughs. Working alongside labs, we discover the materials that will power the new Industrial Revolution.
one_liner: AI-native materials discovery powered by unpublished experimental data
